entries.source:
A long slender staff, made of ancient dragon-bone, with runes emblazoned all over its surface in bright silver.
It hums faintly, as if great power is locked within, yet alone it seems incomplete.
entries.target:
一根又细又长的法杖，由远古龙骨制成，它通体铭刻着亮银色的符文。
它会发出微弱的嗡嗡声，仿佛有一股强大的力量被锁在其中，但单独一件时似乎并不完整。

entries.source:
Assault nearby foes with 4 fast attacks for %d%% (at 0 Hate) to %d%% (at 100+ Hate) damage each. Stalked prey are always targeted if nearby.
		At level 3 the intensity of your assault overwhelms anyone who is struck, reducing their Defense by %d for 4 turns.
		The damage multiplier and Defense reduction increase with your Strength.

		This talent will also attack with your shield, if you have one equipped.
entries.target:
对附近目标发动 4 次快速攻击，每次造成 %d%%（0 仇恨值时）至 %d%%（100+ 仇恨值时）伤害。若附近有被追踪的猎物，则总是攻击它。
		等级 3 时，猛烈攻击会压倒每个被命中的目标，使其闪避降低 %d，持续 4 回合。
		伤害倍率和闪避减值受力量值加成。

		如果你装备了盾牌，这一技能也会用你的盾牌攻击。

entries.source:
You focus your senses, getting information from moments in the future.
		Improves your capacity to see invisible foes by +%d, to see through stealth by +%d, and to perform a critical spell cast by +%d%%.
		The effects will improve with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你集中感官，从未来的片刻中获取信息。
		侦测隐形等级提高 +%d，侦测潜行等级提高 +%d，法术暴击几率提高 +%d%%。
		此效果受法术强度加成。

entries.source: %s resists the sedation!
entries.target: %s抵抗了镇静！

entries.source: Willpower defines your character's ability to concentrate. It increases your mana, stamina and PSI capacity, and your chance to resist mental attacks.
entries.target: 意志属性决定你的角色集中精神的能力。它会提高你的法力值、体力值与灵能值上限，并提高精神豁免。

entries.source:
Enhances your feeding by reducing your targeted foe's resistances, multiplying them by %0.2f and increasing your resistances by the amount drained. Resistance to "all" is not affected.
		Improves with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
提高你的吸食能力，将目标的伤害抗性降低到原来的 %0.2f 倍，并将你自身相应的伤害抗性提高相同数值。对“所有”抗性无效。
		效果受精神强度加成。

entries.source: Halfling
entries.target: 半身人

entries.source: Physical talents of the various horrors of the world.
entries.target: 世界上各种恐魔的物理能力。

entries.source: My old master-- who, though a powerful enchanter, did not compare to you and your glory-- saw fit to imprison me in this fine staff to aid him in his work. Alas, he is long gone, but I despair not, for I have found a mighty new master.
entries.target: 我的前任主人——虽然也是一位强大的附魔师，但与您和您的无上荣光相比根本不值一提——决定将我囚禁在这根精良的法杖中以协助他的工作。唉，他早已不在人世，但我毫不绝望，因为我找到了一位强大的新主人。

entries.source:
You bind light in a glyph on the floor. All enemies walking over the glyph will be slowed by %d%% for 5 turns.
		The glyph is a hidden trap (%d detection and %d disarm power based on your Magic) and lasts for %d turns.
entries.target:
你用光能在地上刻画圣印。所有经过的目标会减速 %d%%，持续 5 回合。
		圣印视为隐藏陷阱（%d 侦查强度，%d 点解除强度，基于魔法）持续 %d 回合。

entries.source: You cannot increase this stat further until next level!
entries.target: 在升级之前，你无法再次提升这项属性！

entries.source: #ORCHID#Your %s CANNOT SHOOT (Resource: %s%s#LAST#).
entries.target: #ORCHID#你的%s无法射击(资源：%s%s#LAST#)。

entries.source: Rescued the merchant from the assassin lord.
entries.target: 从刺客领主手中救回商人。

entries.target: 沉睡

entries.source:
Demonic taint. Yes I have a way to help in the archives. However this is a long process, the subject will need to live here for a while.
She will have to spend 8 hours per day in the regeneration tank.
entries.target:
恶魔污染。是的，我有办法在档案区帮她。不过这个过程很漫长，她需要在这里住上一段时间。
她每天必须在再生槽中待上 8 小时。

entries.source: Dark visions fill your mind as you lift the orb. It is cold to the touch.
entries.target: 当你拿起这个水晶球时，无尽的黑暗扑面而来。这个球摸上去冰凉。

entries.target: 伤害很重要

entries.source: Enhances your Deadly Poison with an insidious agent, causing it to reduce the healing taken by enemies by %d%%.
entries.target: 以阴险成分强化你的致命毒素，中毒目标受到的治疗效果减少 %d%%。
